card: This pull request replaces Boost.Test across all unit tests with an in-tree test runner and assertion framework in `src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}`. Boost.Test imposes external dependency overhead, requires build-system workarounds in Guix and depends, and provides fragmented assertion macros that frequently omit operand values on failure. Replacing Boost Test has been discussed across RFC #34666, issue #8670, and motivated by stability issues such as #36045. Most file changes are mechanical include replacements via scripted-diff, and backward-compatible `BOOST_*` macro shims are retained so ongoing PRs do not suffer merge conflicts. Boost.Test is dropped from CMake, depends, Guix, and vcpkg.
changed_since_previous: Added commits to resolve a clang-tidy warning in `miniminer_tests.cpp`, inline a `CRecipient` constructor in `spend_tests.cpp` to prevent GCC 12 false-positive warnings, and remove low-usage macros (`BOOST_FAIL` and `BOOST_TEST_INFO`).

enables: Incremental migration of unit tests from legacy BOOST_* macros to native CHECK, REQUIRE, and TEST_CASE macros.

evidence: Author cites long-standing discussions on replacing Boost Test in RFC #34666 and issue #8670.
Author notes runtime issues with Boost.Test signal handling, referencing merged PR #36045 ('test: avoid undersized Boost.Test signal stacks').
Author demonstrates inconsistent failure output and compilation errors when asserting equality on custom types like `COutPoint` using Boost macros.
problem: Boost.Test incurs external dependency overhead, requires build-system workarounds in Guix and depends, and provides fragmented assertion macros where common assertions like `BOOST_CHECK` do not print operand values when a test fails.

risk.why: Flaws in the custom test runner could cause unit tests to give false passes, crash during CI runs, or break unit test builds on certain compiler toolchains.

scope_notes: Although touching 167 files, the vast majority of file edits are mechanical single-line include changes applied via scripted-diff. The actual logic is concentrated in `src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}` (~1,240 lines) and packaging files.
summary: Replaces the external Boost.Test unit test framework with an in-tree runner and assertion framework implemented in `src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}`. The framework implements expression decomposition to automatically output evaluated operand values on failure and provides backward-compatible `BOOST_*` macro shims so existing tests continue to build. Build configuration and dependency packaging in CMake, depends, Guix, and vcpkg are updated to drop Boost.Test.
